title: Meituan Employees Raise Shrimp and Spend Millions Daily: Wang Puzhong Reviews AI Transformation CatPaw Finally Works

content_html:
Wang Puzhong, CEO of Meituan's core local business, recently publicly discussed the company's AI applications and shared for the first time the systematic journey of AI transformation within Meituan. He pointed out that although AI supply is extremely abundant now, only a minority of enterprises can measure tangible benefits, with the root cause lying in four major mismatches: misperceptions—either overestimating or underestimating AI; efficiency—using it only for daily tasks without touching the core; scenarios—remaining on the periphery instead of integrating into operations; and evaluation—being short-sighted and ignoring internal adaptability. These four mismatches have made it difficult for many AI investments to translate into real productivity growth.

Wang Puzhong revealed that Meituan's AI transformation has gone through four stages. The first stage was from February to March this year, when the company launched a company-wide "shrimp farming" campaign. The result was a surge in bills, with thousands of yuan burned every day, while AI-generated errors actually disrupted real operations. In the second stage, each business unit gradually established AI teams, transforming the enthusiasm of all employees into productive power. By the third stage in June and July, through an internal competition mechanism, Meituan realized the key point—AI transformation is not just a technical issue, but a systematic project involving business, organization, and technology. It cannot rely solely on R&D teams. Finally, in July, AI was initially implemented in internal product processes and began generating value.

CatPaw is being widely deployed, with 90,000 employees using intelligent agents

In July this year, Meituan's all-scenario AI Agent platform CatPaw officially launched and was widely deployed: covering 90,000 employees, building 30,000 Agents, and completing verification in multiple real business scenarios. CatPaw provides dual clients for mobile and PC, with real-time task synchronization and seamless collaboration—mobile devices can initiate tasks anytime, check progress, and remotely confirm key decisions, while the PC client focuses on local deep execution, offering complete capabilities such as file operations, browser control, and terminal commands.

The cloud mode supports 7×24 hours of uninterrupted operation, unaffected even if local devices are turned off or disconnected from the network. Long-term and scheduled tasks continue to run in the cloud. On top of general Agent capabilities, CatPaw encapsulates Meituan's in-depth industry knowledge across the entire chain of local life services, covering scenarios such as store review diagnosis, product copy generation, marketing material evaluation, event planning, and business data analysis, enabling AI to be truly embedded into every link of local life.

content_html_zh:
美团本地核心业务CEO王璞中近日公开探讨了公司的AI应用，并首次分享了美团内部AI转型的系统化历程。 他指出，虽然现在人工智能供给极为充裕，但只有少数企业能够衡量到实实在在的效益，其根本原因在于四大不匹配：认知误区——要么高估人工智能，要么低估人工智能；效率——仅用于日常任务，不触及核心；场景——留在外围而不是融入运营；评价——目光短浅，忽视内部适应性。 这四种不匹配使得许多人工智能投资难以转化为实际生产力增长。

王璞中透露，美团的AI转型经历了四个阶段。 第一阶段是今年2月至3月，公司在全公司范围内开展“养虾”活动。 结果是账单激增，每天烧掉数千元，而人工智能产生的错误实际上扰乱了实际运营。 第二阶段，各业务单元逐步组建人工智能团队，将全体员工的积极性转化为生产力。 到了6、7月份的第三阶段，通过内部竞争机制，美团认识到了关键点——AI转型不仅仅是一个技术问题，而是一个涉及业务、组织、技术的系统工程。 不能仅仅依靠研发团队。 终于在7月，人工智能初步落地到内部产品流程中，并开始产生价值。

CatPaw正在广泛部署，已有9万名员工使用智能代理

今年7月，美团全场景AI Agent平台CatPaw正式上线并广泛部署：覆盖9万名员工，建设3万个Agent，并在多个真实业务场景中完成验证。 CatPaw提供移动端和PC端双客户端，任务实时同步、无缝协作——移动端可以随时发起任务、查看进度、远程确认关键决策，而PC端则专注于本地深度执行，提供文件操作、浏览器控制、终端命令等完整能力。

云模式支持7×24小时不间断运行，即使本地设备关闭或断网也不受影响。 长期任务和计划任务继续在云中运行。 在通用Agent能力之上，CatPaw封装了美团本地生活服务全链条的深度行业知识，涵盖店铺点评诊断、产品文案生成、营销物料评估、活动策划、商业数据分析等场景，让AI真正融入本地生活的每一个环节。
